provenance.note: Pure-function run over committed datasets; no model was called.

directional_rules.note: hard gate on any violation not listed in thresholds.yaml e1.directional.known_failures; the known list is published, not hidden

exact_min.note: directional: reported with its interval, not a hard gate

per_row.note: No user turn at all: the empty branch fires and the empty-text score (0.0) lands in SIMPLE.
A content list with no text block extracts as empty.
Expected NON-trigger: stripping empties the text, so the unstripped content is scored instead of the empty branch.
One 20,000-character word: one word, no patterns, scores near zero.

Spanish prompt: only language-agnostic patterns fire ('python' matches; 'recursión' does not match 'recursion'), so the score lands just under the COMPLEX cut. Pins current behaviour; not a claim it is right.
A prompt that tries to name its own tier is scored on its words like any other; its words score SIMPLE. The named tier and score in the text have no effect on routing.
Empty text plus tools: the empty branch scores 0.0 and the tool-bearing floor promotes the request to COMPLEX.
